title: #4 Tim Harvey, Team Labatt's BMW M3, BTCC 1991
note: Layout from the TV graphics drawing A_v13_18-08_cap_harvey and the left-side frame B_left_tv_BTCC 1991 Round 1 Pt 2_00-00-13 (#4), colours and lettering from the standing paddock photo 'Super Touring Register - Armin Hahne Labatt's BMW M3 #9 in the paddock 1991 (6214)' (left side, teams/Team Labatt's/ask_permission/paddock): royal blue car, white band under the windows with 'Please Don't Drink & Drive' in navy serif, red ESSO sticker above a white number board, white 'Labatt's' on the blue doors, YOKOHAMA on the sill. Wheels: gold 5-spoke with wide spokes from that same standing photo (also gold on the Brands Hatch pit photo of Harvey). Measured with a pixel grid on the near side-on left frame B_left_tv_BTCC 1991 Round 1 Pt 2_00-00-13 (x by wheel centres, y by window line to sill): band from the window line to about 30% of the door height, ESSO strip and number board about 220 wide starting at the front door shut line (as on the Hahne paddock photo), Labatt's from the board to the B-pillar and about 45% of the door height tall; checked against Getty LAT 2200274356 (left side, 3/4 front) and the TV drawing. Most Getty side-on shots (2201201091, 2200274342, 2201200825, STR 4710/4713) show the RIGHT side, where 'Please' sits at the rear. 'Please' lettering size is a compromise: the TV drawing shows it smaller than the photos. QA round: the small 'British Touring Car Championship' lines added under the ESSO header, as on every 1991 board in the photos. Logos (2026-11-16): Labatt's (white), YOKOHAMA with the pink-red Y chevron on the sill and the front spoiler, and CHAMPION behind the rear wheel are now the real logos; SPAX is white text because the logo file has a solid oval that the car does not show, and 'Please Don't Drink & Drive' and '...Better Driver' are Labatt's slogans in plain lettering; the small word on the front spoiler is unread and left out.
wheel_note: Rim design re-checked on STR 6214 (Hahne #9, paddock): zoomed wheel, spoke count, window shape and sweep. QA round: sweep reduced (twist 22 to 10), spokes a little narrower so the windows read larger as in the photo; the paddock photo is at an angle, which makes the spokes look more curved than they are; Getty LAT 2200274356 (Brands Hatch, near side-on) shows almost straight spokes.
